ue5_build.description: Compile the Unreal Engine 5.8 project with UBT and return structured JSON diagnostic errors.

ue5_verify_replication.description: Run static AST/pattern analysis to verify replication rules, WithValidation on Server RPCs, and UI decoupling.

ue5_verify_gas.description: Statically inspect C++ headers and source files in Source/ for Gameplay Ability System (GAS) and AttributeSet compliance.

ue5_audit_bandwidth.description: Scan Source/ for network performance anti-patterns, raw TArray replication, and missing COND_* filters.

ue5_simulate_ttk.description: Execute mathematical Time-to-Kill (TTK) simulations and combat balance benchmarks.

ue5_simulate_net_pie.description: Execute headless network degradation PIE simulations with latency, loss, and duplication injection.

ue5_run_tests.description: Execute headless automation specs via UnrealEditor-Cmd in null-rhi mode and return test status JSON.
